spoken_summary: Kamala Harris gives a victory speech, stating that the celebration is not just about her, but about everyone and their city. She says they are a "voice for justice" and will continue their work for the next four years. She encourages her supporters to celebrate responsibly, saying "walk home, don't drive," and then get back to work the next day. She repeatedly thanks her supporters.

central_claim: Archival footage from 2007 shows Kamala Harris has a long history of celebrating victories by dedicating her work to the people she represents.
intended_effect: To humanize Kamala Harris and portray her as a consistent and dedicated public servant, fostering a sense of pride and long-term support among viewers.
